summary: Hardened the GitHub security workflow regression gate so it now protects minimal workflow permissions plus npm audit Summary/artifact evidence tokens.

details: Requires CodeQL workflow to keep explicit permissions for actions:read, contents:read and security-events:write.
Requires Dependency Review workflow to keep contents:read and pull-requests:read permissions.
Requires Security CI to keep contents:read permission, GitHub Step Summary output, npm-audit-triage artifact upload, seven-day retention and if-no-files-found warning behavior.

notes: This does not require npm registry access or a new package-lock.json.
Vercel remains blocked by build-rate-limit rather than a verified code failure.
next_steps: Run GitHub Actions to produce npm-audit-triage artifact.
Generate package-lock.json with npm run supply-chain:lockfile once npm@10.8.2 is available.
Use npm audit and floating dependency outputs to pin vulnerable/floating packages.
